source: tool-argument vectors from RFC-0042 §3.2 (fork PR #14), keeping only the rows whose result equals ai@7.0.127 src/generate-text/parse-tool-call.ts: a provider-executed dynamic call without a tool set is parsed by parseProviderExecutedDynamicToolCall (:199-224) with safeParseJSON (@ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.55 src/parse-json.ts:89, secure-json-parse.ts; unchanged since 5.0.53); a failure becomes an invalid call whose input is the verbatim text (:112-133)

notes.providerInput: the provider's argument text, verbatim; must survive RawToolCall Rust->JSON->Rust byte for byte
notes.expect.input: the parsed value as JSON.parse gives it, compared with JSON semantics (numbers by value) after ToolCall Rust->JSON->Rust
notes.duplicateKeys: JSON.parse keeps the last value of a repeated key: {"a":2}
